sections.title: Market Pulse: AI Earnings Fuel Optimism Ahead of Key Economic Data

items.headline: U.S. Futures Point Higher, Driven by Strong Tech Earnings and Easing Inflation Expectations
items.summary: U.S. stock futures are showing gains this morning as investors continue to digest robust earnings reports from major tech companies like Microsoft and Amazon, which have renewed optimism around AI investments. Cooler inflation data projections for June are also contributing to a positive sentiment, though Treasury yields remain elevated. The market awaits key economic data releases, including the Employment Cost Index and Consumer Sentiment.

sections.title: Major Indices Performance (As of July 30th Close & July 31st Pre-market)
Top Movers: Earnings Drive Significant Shifts

items.headline: Microsoft Rallies on Azure Cloud Growth
items.summary: Microsoft Corporation ($MSFT) surged 16% on Thursday following its earnings report, which showcased stronger-than-expected Azure cloud growth, signaling robust demand in the artificial intelligence sector.

items.headline: Amazon Beats Revenue Expectations Post-Market
items.summary: Amazon ($AMZN) climbed more than 9% in extended trading after Thursday's close. The e-commerce giant reported better-than-expected second-quarter revenue, primarily fueled by strong performance in its cloud-computing business.

items.headline: Micron Technology Jumps on AI Demand Optimism
items.summary: Micron Technology ($MU) gained 18% on Thursday, benefiting from a broad rally in semiconductor stocks and renewed investor appetite for AI-linked companies.

items.headline: Meta Platforms Drops on Soft Guidance
items.summary: Meta Platforms Inc. ($META) saw an 8% decline on Thursday after the company issued soft revenue guidance and reported a significant 91% drop in its second-quarter free cash flow, raising concerns among investors.

items.headline: Inovio Pharmaceuticals Experiences Significant Pre-market Drop
items.summary: Inovio Pharmaceuticals, Inc. ($INO) was among the top pre-market losers on Thursday, seeing a substantial decline.

items.headline: Lam Research Surges on AI Demand and Positive Guidance
items.summary: Lam Research ($LRCX) soared 18% on Thursday after posting strong results driven by AI demand and providing positive guidance, contributing to the semiconductor rally. It is also listed as a pre-market gainer today.

sections.title: Market News & Economic Calendar: Inflation and Earnings in Focus

items.headline: Key Economic Data Releases Scheduled for Friday
items.summary: Today's economic calendar includes several important data releases. The Employment Cost Index for Q2, a key inflation indicator, is due at 7:30 AM ET, with a forecast of 0.8%. The Chicago PMI for July, reflecting manufacturing health, and the final University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment Index for July, are both expected at 9:00 AM ET.

items.headline: Semiconductor Sector Leads Gains on AI Optimism
items.summary: The semiconductor sector continues to exhibit strong performance, driving broader market gains. The iShares Semiconductor ETF ($SOXX) climbed over 8% on Thursday, propelled by robust earnings from companies like Microsoft and Lam Research, which highlighted strong AI-driven demand.

items.headline: Linde Reports Strong Q2 Earnings, Exceeding Expectations
items.summary: Linde plc ($LIN) reported strong second-quarter 2026 results before market open. The company's adjusted diluted earnings per share (EPS) reached $4.50, marking a 10% increase year-over-year, on sales of $9.3 billion, up 9% from the prior year.

items.headline: Portland General Electric Posts Q2 Results
items.summary: Portland General Electric Company ($POR) announced second-quarter 2026 net income of $68 million, or $0.59 per diluted share. The company reaffirmed its 2026 adjusted earnings guidance, reflecting strong operational execution and increased industrial customer demand.

items.headline: Cooler June PCE Inflation Data and GDP Projections
items.summary: The U.S. PCE price index for June is anticipated to show a slight decrease of 0.1% month-on-month, with the core measure rising 0.2%, suggesting an easing inflation trend. Additionally, U.S. Q2 GDP is projected to be 2.1%.
